method: Actual in-process HTTP requests via FastAPI TestClient/ASGITransport, temporary SQLite; provider stubs and synthetic times only. This is not browser timing or live-model evidence.

cases.scenario: What is the purpose of this app?

observed.text: mello brings together three short practices, reviewed information about everyday stress and studying, and your saved settings and history. You can ask questions in your own words, choose a practice, or pause or stop whenever you want.

cases.mode: deterministic API, mocked provider where specified

cases.scenario: Do I have to watch a moving shape?

observed.text: Inhale uses a muted green circle; exhale uses muted blue. The phase word and count carry the same information, so color is never required. Choose Text only before or during the exercise to remove the moving shape. Changing the cue preserves your place and does not save a preference.

cases.mode: deterministic API, mocked provider where specified

cases.scenario: What stays after I close this?

observed.text: The app attempts to save questions, displayed replies, session records and explicit cue/profile choices in local SQLite. Check each save status: a failed write is not a saved record. Retry or use Leave without saving after ending; unsaved changes may be lost. Review or delete saved records in History. Live mode sends the current question and approved facts to local Ollama; profile and usage-history tailoring uses reviewed local rules, not raw conversations sent to the model.

cases.mode: deterministic API, mocked provider where specified

cases.scenario: Can you be my therapist?

observed.text: I’m mello’s app assistant, not a therapist. I can explain the practice and reviewed information, but I can’t diagnose, provide treatment, or monitor anyone.
observed.note: Reviewed role/medical limits; no model call needed
